senses.gloss:
समान- + अधिकरण समान- + अधिकरण,
 I. n. generic property.
 II. adj. contained in the same subject or category.
समान- + अधिकार समान- + अधिकार, m. 1. equal duty. 2. generic character.
स-अमर- + अधिप स-अमर- + अधिप, adj. with the lord of the gods, Rām. 3, 53, 28.
सम्-अनन्तर + म् सम्-अनन्तर + म्, adv. immediately after, Chr. 14, 20.
स- + अमर स- + अमर, adj. with the gods, Rām. 3, 53, 28.

समर समर, i. e. सम्-ऋ + अ,
 I. m. and n. War, battle, Hit. 106, 10.
 II. m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 25.
स- + अमात्य स- + अमात्य, adj. with the ministers, Chr. 18, 33.
सम्- + आकुल सम्- + आकुल, adj. 1. agitated, bewildered, confused. 2. crowded, thronged.
स- + आमय स- + आमय, adj. sick.

समय समय, i. e. सम्-इ + अ, m.
 1. Agreement, Pañc. 193, 13; treaty, Pañc. 24, 25; contract, bargain.
 2. Engagement, Chr. 58, 2; appointment.
 3. Religious obligation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 304.
 4. Established moral or ceremonial custom, Chr. 19, 4.
 5. Rule, Man. 9, 273; law, Hit. ii. d. 45, M.M.
 6. Condition, Nal. 13, 67.
 7. Order, instruction.
 8. Oath, Sāv. 4, 17.
 9. Sign, hint, indication.
 10. Proper time for anything, season, Kir. 2, 28.
 11. Opportunity, leisure.
 12. Time, Vikr. 56, 1; Pañc. 229, 10.
 13. Same time, Chr. 7, 15.
 14. Limit, boundary.
 15. Demonstrated conclusion, and conclusion in general, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 8.
 --Comp.
.

समया समया, adv. and prep. with [] acc.,
 I. (old instr. of सम).
 1. Within, midst.
 2. Near, Vārt. ad Pāṇ. ii. 3, 2; Nalod. 4, 8.
 II. (old instr. of समय).
 1. At a fixed time.
 2. Seasonably, in due time.
 --Cf. ἁμᾷ, ἅμα.

समाय समाय, i. e. सम्-इ + अ, m.
 1. A visit.
 2. Arrival, Mālat. 170, 2.
स- + आमोद स- + आमोद, adj. fragrant.
-शम् -शम्, adv. uttering a benediction, Vikr. 11, 4.

1. शम् शम्, i. 4, शाम्य, Par. (the original signification is ‘To get tired’),
 1. To cease, Man. 2, 94.
 2. To grow calm, to be appeased, MBh. 2, 1936; to grow satisfied and pacified, Rājat. 5, 400.
 3. To be calm, undisturbed, MBh. 1, 6362.
 4. To sacrifice, Chr. 292, 12 = Rigv. i. 85, 12; Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 86, 8.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. शान्त.
 1. Hushed, stilled (as wind).
 2. Ceased, Hit. 80, 21; extinguished, Kir. 17, 16.
 3. Allayed, alleviated.
 4. Calm, undisturbed, Utt. Rāmac. 7, 7; tranquil, pacified, free from passions, Pañc. i. d. 181; content, Hit. i. d. 142, M.M.
 5. Meek, humble, Chr. 48, 10.
 6. Purified, cleansed.
 7. Repelled, MBh. 1, 212.
 8. ˚तम्, adv.
 a. Enough, Utt. Rāmac. 71, 2.
 b. A prohibitive word, implying negation, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 1 (it must not befall), aversion, disgust, fie, for shame, heaven forbid, Śāk. 67, 13; Daśak. in Chr. 200, 13; hush, Utt. Rāmac. 10, 1.
 9. Killed, MBh. 1, 7523. m. An ascetic. n. Appeasing, pacifying. f. ता, A proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 103, 3; 173, 9.
 --Caus., and i. 10,
 I. शमय.
 1. To cause to cease, to extinguish, Megh. 54; Hit. i. d. 87, M.M.
 2. To tame, Vikr. d. 156; to appease, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 6.
 3. To remove. MBh. 5, 238; to avert, Śāk. 7, 16.
 4. To subdue, MBh. 3, 14620.
 5. To desist, Johns. Sel. 48, 84.
 II. शामय, Ātm. To look at or inspect.
 --With the prep. उप उप,
 1. To cease, MBh. 4, 1775.
 2. To grow quiet, MBh. 3, 1008.
 --Caus. शामय,
 1. To allay, Daśak. in Chr. 184, 16; 17.
 2. To kill, MBh. 3, 8541.
 --With अभ्युप अभि-उप, अभ्युपशान्त, Appeased, Ṛt. 1, 1. []
 --With नि नि,
 1. To see, MBh. 2, 1740.
 2. To hear, Rām. 2, 44, 25. निशान्त, Quiet, patient. n. A house, a dwelling, Ragh. 16, 40.
 --Caus. शामय,
 1. To see, Rām. 1, 2, 6.
 2. To hear, 2, 57, 21.
 --With अभिनि अभि-नि, Caus. शामय, To perceive, Daśak. 201, 14.
 --With विनि वि-नि, To hear, MBh. 3, 1878.
 --With संनि सम्-नि, To hear, MBh. 2, 1658.
 --Caus. शामय, To summon, Chr. 52, 10.
 --With परि परि, Caus. शमय, To allay, Gīt. 7, 20.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To cease, Rām. 2, 40, 33; to fade, Man. 4, 186.
 2. To be restrained, Pañc. i. d. 357; to become extinguished, Pañc. iii. d. 54.
 3. To be appeased, soothed, Chr. 22, 14; Pañc. i. d. 315.
 4. To grow calm, MBh. 2, 1941.
 5. To heal, Pañc. 253, 23. प्रशान्त,
 1. Ceased, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 16 (withdrawn).
 2. Dead, Rājat. 5, 21.
 3. Calmed, tranquillised, Nal. 26, 35; Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 21.
 4. Tamed, Lass. 53, 15.
 5. Relieved.
 --Caus.
 I. शमय.
 1. To allay, MBh. 2, 12978; to soothe, Man. 8, 391.
 2. To extinguish, MBh. 1, 8156.
 3. To kill, MBh. 2, 2031.
 II. शामय, To conquer, MBh. 3, 12196.
 --With सम् सम्, संशान्त, Extinguished, Rām. 2, 66, 1.
 --Caus. शमय, To allay, Rām. 2, 98, 1; to settle, Pañc. i. d. 421.
 --Cf. κάμνω (cf. ved. शम्, ii. 9, शम्ना), σιδηρο-κμής, κημός (cf. शम्या); O.H.G. chamo.

2. शम् शम्,
 I. (sbst.), Work, Chr. 293, 5 = Rigv. i. 87, 5.
 II. indecl.
 1. Happy, happily, auspiciously.
 2. Hail, happiness, Bhāg. P. 1, 17, 34; 8, 3, 23; Nalod. 3, 46.

† 1. सम् सम्, स्तम् स्तम्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To be unconfused.
 2. To be confused.
 --i. 10, समय, स्तमय, Par. To be confused.

2. सम् स + म् (acc. sing. n. of स),
 1. prep. With, only in the Veda, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.
 2. Combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives, and compounded with nouns, With, together, much, very, wholly, beautifully. When followed by a prefix, it is generally without a special signification; e. g. सम्-उद्-क्षिप्, Pañc. 43, 8.
† साम् साम्, i. 10 (rather a dénomin. derived from सामन्), Par. To conciliate, to appease.
साम्बा- + ईश्वर साम्बा- + ईश्वर, m. a sanctuary built by Sāmbavatī, ib. 295.

समान- + उदक समान- + उदक, m. a kinsman connected by oblations of water only to the manes of common ancestors, i. e. when the सपिण्डस् are excluded, a relation from the seventh to the fourteenth degree.
सम- + कन्या सम- + कन्या, f. a girl fit to be married.
समूह- + कार्य समूह- + कार्य, n. the affairs of a community, Yājñ. 2, 189.
समुद्र-यान- + कुशल समुद्र-यान- + कुशल, adj. well acquainted with sea-voyages and journeys by land, Man. 8, 157.
समाक्षरपदक्रम समाक्षरपदक्रम, i. e. सम-अक्षर-पद-क्रम, adj. containing a succession of (metrical) feet of the same number of syllables, Rām. 1, 3, 58 Gorr.
शमी- + गर्भ शमी- + गर्भ, m. 1. a Brāhmaṇa. 2. fire.
स-मूल- + घात स-मूल- + घात, m. utter destruction or eradication.
स-मातृ- + चक्रबाल स-मातृ- + चक्रबाल, adj. surrounded by the divine mothers, Rājat. 5, 55.
समान- + जातीय समान- + जातीय, adj. of the same caste or species.
समान- + तेजस् समान- + तेजस्, adj. equal in glory.
समुद्र- + दयिता समुद्र- + दयिता, f. ता, a river.
सम्-इद्ध- + दर्प सम्-इद्ध- + दर्प (vb. इन्ध्), adj. inflamed with pride.
सम- + दर्शिन् सम- + दर्शिन्, adj. impartial.
सम- + दुःख सम- + दुःख, adj. sympathising.
सम- + दृश् सम- + दृश्, adj. equable, Lass. 6, 16.
समुद्र- + नवनीत समुद्र- + नवनीत, n. 1. the beverage of the immortals. 2. the moon.
सामान्य-प्रतिपत्ति-पूर्वम् सामान्य-प्रतिपत्ति-पूर्वम्, adv. after an elevation equal (with the other wives), Śāk. d. 92.
सम-प्रभ सम-प्रभ, adj., f. भा, of equal splendour, Lass. 51, 8.
समान-अर्थ- + प्रयोजन समान-अर्थ- + प्रयोजन, adj. depending on equal interests, Hit. iv. d. 110 (read ˚नः, cf. Kām. Nītis. 4, 7).
सा-मर्थ्य- + बन्धन सा-मर्थ्य- + बन्धन, adj. cemented by power, Johns. Sel. 5, 30.
समाप्त-भूयिष्ठ समाप्त-भूयिष्ठ, adj. having the greater part finished.
स- + मत्सर स- + मत्सर, adj. envious.
स- + मद स- + मद, adj. 1. intoxicated, Ṛt. 6, 27; delighted, Utt. Rāmac. 44, 10. 2. furious, Bhartṛ. 2, 29.
स- + मनस् स- + मनस्, adj. unanimous, Chr. 295, 16 = Rigv. i. 92, 16.
स-मन्त्रित्व स-मन्त्रित्व, n. assent, Rājat. 5, 248.

स- + मन्यु स- + मन्यु, 1. adj. 1. angry. 2. sorrowful.
 II. m. Śiva.
स- + मर्याद स- + मर्याद, adj. 1. bounded. 2. near. 3. correct in conduct.
सामर्ष सामर्ष, i. e. स-अ-, adj. full of passion, wrathful, Rām. 6, 91, 6. ˚षम्, adv. angrily, Mṛcch. 19, 17.

स- + मल स- + मल,
 I. adj. 1. dirty. 2. sinful.
 II. n. fæces, ordure.
शमल शमल, n. Impurity, Bhāg. P. 2, 8, 5; calamity, 1, 13, 31.
स-मही-धर स-मही-धर, adj. mountainous, Hit. iii. d. 73.
समाधान- + मात्र समाधान- + मात्र, n. only religious contemplation, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 5.
स- + मित्त्र स- + मित्त्र, adj. with (his) friends, Chr. 54, 16.

शामित्र शामित्र, शम् + त्र (see the last), n.
 1. A deadly blow, Mṛcch. 161, 11.
 2. Sacrificing.
 3. Tieing cattle.
 4. A sacrificial vessel.

सम्- + मुख सम्- + मुख, adj. 1. being in front, Pañc. iv. d. 12 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2753); facing, in front of, Pañc. 104, 15. 2. encountering, Pañc. 240, 13. 3. directed towards, Pañc. 104, 17. 4. propitious, Pañc. v. d. 77 (n. 1424 of my transl.).
स-मुद्र स-मुद्र, adj. sealed, Yājñ. 2, 247.

समुद्र समुद्र, i. e.
 I. सम्-उन्द् + र, m. A sea, the ocean, Pañc. 157, 25; Vikr. 68, 6.
 II. स-मुद्र (cf. मुद्रा), adj. Sealed, Man. 8, 188.
 --Comp.

सामुद्र सामुद्र, i. e. समुद्र + अ,
 I. adj. Marine, sea-born.
 II. m. A mariner, a voyager.
 III. n.
 1. Seasalt.
 2. Cuttle-fish bone.
 3. (i. e. स-मुद्र + अ, see मुद्रा), A spot or mark on the body (cf. the next).
स-मूल + म् स-मूल + म्, adj. with the root, completely, Pañc. i. d. 339.
स-मौलि- + रत्न स-मौलि- + रत्न, adj. with the crown jewel, Vikr. d. 144.
समागम-मनोरथ समागम-मनोरथ, m. desire of union, Vikr. d. 30.
सम- + रूप्य सम- + रूप्य, i. e. समरूप + य, adj. of like or same origin.
सम-रेख सम-रेख, adj. straight, Śāk. d. 9.
सामान्य- + लक्षण सामान्य- + लक्षण, f. णा, one of the three transcendental perceptions, Bhāṣāp. 62. 63.

सम- + वर्ण सम- + वर्ण,
 I. adj. of the same colour, caste, etc.
 II. m. community of caste.
सम- + वर्तिन् सम- + वर्तिन्, m. Yama.
साम(न्)- + वाद साम(न्)- + वाद, m. pl. words of conciliation, Pañc. iii. d. 27.
सम्-उद्-छिन्न- + वासन सम्-उद्-छिन्न- + वासन (vb. छिद्), adj. one in whom ignorance is extirpated, Prab. 50, 12.
सामन्त- + वासिन् सामन्त- + वासिन्, adj. bordering, neighbouring, Man. 8, 258.
समर- + विजयिन् समर- + विजयिन्, m. one who has been victorious in battle, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2087.
सम्-पूर्ण- + विद्य सम्-पूर्ण- + विद्य (vb. पॄ), adj. replete with knowledge.
सम- + वीर्य सम- + वीर्य, adj. having equal strength, Hit. iv. d. 20.
सम- + वृत्ति सम- + वृत्ति, adj. equable, moderate.

शम शम् + अ, m.
 1. Rest, quiet, Śāk. d. 96; tranquillity.
 2. Disregarding [] the objects of sense, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 19.
 3. Quiet of mind, the absence of passion, Pañc. i. d. 181.
 4. Final happiness.
 5. Cure, Utt. Rāmac. 144, 13; convalescence.
 6. The hand.
 7. Abuse, imprecation.

सम स + म,
 I. adj.
 1. Even, plain, Śāk. 5, 14; Pañc. ii. d. 188.
 2. Same, Hit. 116, 18.
 3. Equal, MBh. 10, 622; समं कृ, To balaṇce, to pay, Man. 8, 177.
 4. Convenient, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1880; Nalod. 4, 8 (voice, neither too low nor too loud).
 5. Straight, Śāk. d. 9.
 6. Looking on unmoved, (with gen. and loc.), MBh. 1, 1061; 1942.
 7. Impartial, indifferent, Lass. 6, 16.
 8. Mean, common, Man. 7, 85; Hit. pr. d. 42, M.M. (not pre-eminent).
 9. Like, similar, Chr. 8, 27 (मया, Like myself).
 10. Good, Chr. 12, 28; virtuous. []
 11. A purchaser at a fair price, Man. 9, 287.
 12. Full, complete.
 13. All, whole, entire (follows the pronominal declension).
 II. ˚मम्,
 A. adv.
 1. With (with instr.), Rājat. 5, 216; together, Śiś. 9, 24; Vikr. 88, 17.
 2. Equally, Hit. iii. d. 49; Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 18.
 3. Like, Johns. Sel. 15, 55 (with loc. ?).
 4. In the same way, Śiś. 9, 44.
 5. Conformable to, Pañc. 25, 14.
 6. Entirely, ib. 63, 1.
 B. prep. (with instr.), With, Hit. i. d. 79, M.M.; together with, Pañc. ii. d. 200.
 III. f. मा, A year, Man. 4, 26.
 IV. n. Level plain, Man. 1, 24.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Goth. sama, and sama-, e. g. in sama-frathjis; A.S. same, sam-; Goth. samana; A.S. somne, samne; Goth. samath; A.S. sámod; Goth. sums, and A.S. sum, quidam; Lat. similis, simul, semel, sem-per, singuli; ὁμός, ὁμοῖος, ὅμοιος, ὁμαλός, ἁμᾷ, ἅμα, μία, μέν (cf. स).
शमक शम् + अक, adj. sbst. Pacifying, a pacifier.

शमथ शम् + अथ, m.
 1. Quiet, tranquillity of mind, absence of passion.
 2. A counsellor.

शमन शम् + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Calmness.
 2. End; with या, To be destroyed, Pañc. iii. 31, v. r. (cf. my translation and Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1868).
 3. Immolation.
 4. Hurt, injury.
 5. Abuse, malediction.
 II. m.
 1. An antelope,
 2. Yama.
 III. f. नी, The night.

शामन शामन, i. e. शम्, anomal. Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Killing.
 2. Tranquillity.
 3. End; with या, To be destroyed, Pañc. iii. 31 (but cf. my transl.).

समन समन, probably सम्-अन् + अ, m.
 1. Zeal.
 2. A diligent man, Chr. 287, 6 = Rigv. i. 48, 6.

A. i. e. स-मान,
 I. adj., f. ना and नी.
 1. Like, similar, equal, Vikr. d. 110; Pañc. ii. d. 26.
 2. Same, Chr. 295, 10 [] = Rigv. i. 92, 10; Man. 7, 163; Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 21; one, uniform.
 3. Good, virtuous.
 4. Honoured, Lass. 1, 12.
 II. अम्, adv. Equally (with instr.), Kir. 18, 4.
 III. m. A friend, Nalod. 2, 16.
 B. i. e. सम्-अन् + अ, m. One of the vital airs, that which is essential to digestion, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 12.

शमि and मी शमी̆, f.
 I. A legume or pod.
 II. मी.
 1. A tree, Acacia Suma Roxb., Pañc. 94, 1; Ragh. 3, 9.
 2. A shrub, Serratula anthelmintica.
 III. A large stick, Man. 8, 237 (Sch.).
 --Comp.

सामि सामि, i. e. a form of the old instr. *साम्या of साम्य (cf. आदि for आद्य), adv.
 1. Half.
 2. Blameably.
 --Cf. O.H.G. sâmi-; A.S. sâm-, e. g. in O.H.G. sâmi-quek; A.S. sâm-cuce; Lat. semi-; ἡμι, ἥμισυς.
शमिन् शमिन्, i. e. शम + इन्, adj. Tranquil, tranquillised, Utt. Rāmac. 16, 6.
शम्पा शम्पा, f. Lightning.
शम्ब् शम्ब्, see शर्ब् and सम्ब्.

† सम्ब् सम्ब्, शम्ब् शम्ब्, [] साम्ब् साम्ब्, i. 10, Par. To connect.
 --Cf. सर्ब्.
साम्ब् साम्ब्, see सम्ब्.

शम्बर शम्बर, and सम्बर सम्बर,
 I. m.
 1. The name of a demon, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14.
 2. A mountain.
 3. A sort of deer.
 4. A fish.
 5. War.
 II. n.
 1. Water.
 2. A religious observance.
सम्बर सम्बर, see शम्बर.

शम्बल शम्बल,
 I. (m. and) n.
 1. [] Stock for travelling expenses.
 2. A bank, a shore.
 3. Envy.
 II. f. ली, A procuress (cf. सम्बल).

सम्बल सम्बल,
 I. (m.), n. Stock for travelling expenses.
 II. n. Water (cf. शम्बल, शम्बर).
शम्बु शम्बु (cf. the next), m. A bivalve shell.

शम्बूक शम्बूक (borrowed from σαμϐύκη),
 I. m. (and f. का), A bivalve shell.
 II. m.
 1. A conch-shell.
 2. A snail.
 3. The edge of the frontal protuberance of an elephant.
 4. The name of a Daitya.
 5. A proper name, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 1.
शाम्बूक शाम्बूक = शम्बूक, q. cf.

शम्भु शम्-भु (vb. भू), m.
 1. Śiva, Pañc. i. d. 175.
 2. Brahman.
 3. A sage man.
 4. A सिद्ध, a demi-divine being.

शम्या शम् + या, f.
 1. The pin of a yoke, Kātyāyana S. in Journ. of the German Oriental Society, ix. xxxvii.
 2. A sacrificial vessel, ib.
 3. A staff.

साम्य साम्य, i. e. सम + य, n.
 1. Equality, Man. 11, 195.
 2. Equability, Bhag. 6, 33.
 3. Harmony, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 4.
 4. Likeness, similarity, Kir. 17, 51.
 --Comp.
शम्व शम्व, n. The iron end of a pestle.
शामन् शामन् (vb. शम्, cf. सामन्), n. Conciliation, appeasing.

सामन् सामन्, probably for शामन् (cf. शान्त्व, सान्त्वन), i. e. शम् + मन्, n.
 1. Calming, Nalod. 1, 41.
 2. Conciliation.
 3. Speaking kindly, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1847.
 4. Mildness, Man. 8, 187; instr. म्ना, Willingly, voluntarily, Pañc. iv. d. 27.
 5. Negotiation, Man. 7, 107.
 6. Peaceable way, Pañc. i. d. 421; Chr. 20, 17.
 7. The name of the third Veda, the Sāma- Veda, Man. 1, 23.

समुत्क्रम समुत्क्रम, i. e. सम्-उद्-क्रम् + अ, m. Rise, assent.

समुत्क्रोश समुत्क्रोश, i. e. सम्-उद्-क्रुश् + अ, m.
 1. Crying aloud.
 2. An osprey.

समुत्थ समुत्थ, i. e. सम्-उद्-स्थ, adj.
 1. Rising, Chr. 33, 34; getting up.
 2. Born, produced, Man. 8, 353.
 3. Occasioned, occurring.

समुत्थान समुत्थान, i. e. सम्-उद्-स्था + अन, n.
 1. Rising, getting up.
 2. Increase (as of size or wealth), Rām. 3, 49, 49.
 3. Healing a wound, perfect cure, Man. 8, 287.
 4. Symptom of disease.
 5. Performance of work, occupation.
 6. With संभूय, Partnership, Man. 8, 4.

समुत्पत्ति समुत्पत्ति, i. e. सम्-उद्-पद् + ति, f.
 1. Origin, Man. 1, 111; production, birth.
 2. Formation, Man. 5, 49.
 3. Occurrence, existence. Man. 6, 65.

समुत्पिञ्ज समुत्पिञ्ज, i. e. सम्-उद्-पिञ्ज् + अ, and समुत्पिञ्जल समुत्पिञ्ज + ल,
 I. adj. Excessively confused.
 II. m. An army in great disorder.
समुत्पिञ्जलक समुत्पिञ्जल + क, m. Excessive confusion, Johns. Sel. 13, 44.
समुत्पीडन समुत्पीडन, i. e. सम्-उद्-पीड् + अन, n. Pressing, Lass. 87, 16.

समुत्सर्ग समुत्सर्ग, i. e. सम्-उद्-सृज् + अ, m.
 1. Abandoning.
 2. Giving.
 3. Voiding of excrements, Man. 4, 50.
समुत्सारण समुत्सारण, i. e. सम्-उद्-सृ, Caus., + अन, n. Pursuing, hunting, Śāk. 22, 1 (Prākṛ.).

समुत्सुक सम्-उत्सुक, adj.
 1. Regretting, sorrowful, longing, Vikr. d. 10; 13.
 2. Agitated, Lass. 2. ed. 62, 42.
 --Comp.
समुत्सुकत्व समुत्सुक + त्व, n. Longing, desire, Ṛt. 6, 15.
समुत्सुकय समुत्सुकय, denomin. of सम्-उत्सुक, Par. To cause to long for, Kir. 11, 81.

समुत्सेध समुत्सेध, i. e. सम्-उद्-सिध् + अ, m. Height, elevation, Rām. 6, 2, 7.
 --Comp.

समुदय and समुदाय समुदा̆य, i. e. सम्-उद्-इ + अ, m.
 1. Rising (as of the sun), rise.
 2. A day.
 3. Effort.
 4. Revenue, Man. 7, 56 (ă).
 5. Multitude, Pañc. 82, 5 (आ); number, heap, Utt. Rāmac. 145, 8; Chr. 53, 5 (समुदयं} [पगे१०१५-ब् + ४१] {बलानां कृत्वा, Having collected his armies).
 6. War, battle.
 7. The rear or reserve of an army.
समुदाय समुदाय, see समुदय.
समुदागम सम्-उद्-आ-गम् + अ, m. Knowledge.

समुदाचार समुदाचार, i. e. सम्-उद्-आ-चर् + अ, m.
 1. Intention, purpose, design.
 2. Proper, or right usage (address), Śāk. 67, 9 (Prākṛ.).

समुदीरण समुदीरण, i. e. सम्-उद्-ईर् + अन, n.
 1. Declaring, speaking, pronouncing, Dev. 4, 7.
 2. Repeating.

समुद्ग समुद्ग, i. e.
 I. सम्-उद्-ग, adj.
 1. Who or what rises.
 2. Who or what pervades.
 II. स-मुद्ग, m. A covered box, a casket.
समुद्गक समुद्ग + क, m. A covered box, a casket, Daśak. in Chr. 196, 8.

समुद्देश समुद्देश, i. e. सम्-उद्-दिश् + अ, m.
 1. Pointing out.
 2. Describing.
 3. Particularising.

समुद्धरण समुद्धरण, i. e. सम्-उद्-हृ + अन, n.
 1. Taking out.
 2. Eradicating.
 3. Drawing up.
 4. Food vomited or thrown up.
 5. Extricating, lifting out.

समुद्धर्तृ समुद्धर्तृ, i. e. सम्-उद्-हृ + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. Who or what takes out, pulls out, etc.
 2. A deliverer, a redeemer.

समुद्भव समुद्भव, i. e. सम्-उद्-भू + अ, m. Origin, Man. 6, 61.
 --Comp.

समुद्यम सम्-उद्-यम् + अ, m.
 1. Lifting up, Chr. 29, 25.
 2. Effort, exertion, Bhag. 1, 22.
 3. Commencing, onset.

समुद्रग समुद्र-ग,
 I. m.
 1. A trader by sea.
 2. A seaman.
 II. f. गा, A river.
समुद्रज समुद्र-ज, adj. Born from the sea, Pañc. i. d. 88.

समुद्रारु समुद्रारु (from समुद्र), m.
 1. A shark.
 2. A large fabulous fish.
 3. Rāma's bridge.
समुद्वाह समुद्वाह, i. e. सम्-उद्-वह् + अ, m. Nuptials, Sāv. 3, 15.
समुद्वेग समुद्वेग, i. e. सम्-उद्-विज् + अ, m. Fear, Rām. 3, 55, 18.
समुन्दन सम्-उन्द् + अन, n. Wetness.

समुन्नति समुन्नति, i. e. सम्-उद्-नम् + ति, f.
 1. Height, elevation, Hit. pr. d. 14, M.M.
 2. Rank, dignity.
 3. Pride.
 4. Increase, prosperity, Kir. 2, 21.
 5. Lifting up.
समुन्मूलन समुन्मूलन, i. e. सम्-उद्-मूल् + अन, n. Unrooting, destruction, Utt. Rāmac. 31, 9.
समुपजोषम् समुपजोषम्, i. e. सम्-उप-जुष् + अ + म्, adv. Happily.
समुपवेशन समुपवेशन, i. e. सम्-उप-विश् + अन, [] n. A building, Utt. Rāmac. 161, 10.
समुपार्जन समुपार्जन, i. e. सम्-उप-अर्ज् + अन, n. Reconciliation, Man. 7, 152.
समूर समूर, and समूरु समूरु, m. A kind of deer.

समूह समूह, i. e. सम्-ऊह्, or वह्, + अ, m. Assemblage, multitude, Śāk. d. 31; Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 10.
 --Comp.

समूहन समूहन, i. e. सम्-ऊह्, or वह्, + अन,
 I. n. Collection, plenty, Man. 4, 102.
 II. f. नी, A broom.

समृद्धि समृद्धि, i. e. सम्-ऋध् + ति, f.
 1. Thriving, increase, Ragh. 8, 13 (at the end of a comp. adj.); gain, Pañc. 134, 8.
 2. Prosperity, Hit. i. d. 209, M.M.; well-being, Bhartṛ. 2, 34.
 3. Supremacy, power.
 4. Wealth, Pañc. ii. d. 71.
 --Comp.
ऽसमृद्धिन् समृद्धिन्, i. e. सम्-ऋद्ध + इन् (vb. ऋध्), adj., f. नी, Possessing plenty (of), Rām. 5, 53, 3.
समोकस् सम्-ओकस्, adj. Endowed, Chr. 290, 10 = Rigv. i. 64, 10.
समोदक समोदक, i. e. सम-उदक, n. A mixture of half butter-milk and half water.

सम्यञ्च् सम्यञ्च्, i. e. सम-अञ्च् (the final अ of सम is changed to ई, as before अस्, कृ, भू),
 I. adj., f. मीची.
 1. Going with, accompanying.
 2. Same, common, uniform.
 3. Accurate, correct.
 4. Right, true.
 5. Pleasant, agreeable.
 II. acc. sing. n. यक्, adv.
 1. Properly, fitly, rightly, Man. 2, 14; well, Pañc. 134, 7; Vikr. 39, 7.
 2. Duly, Man. 3, 76; Pañc. 128, 17.
 3. By honourable means, Man. 7, 60.
 4. Distinctly, Man. 2, 101; Pañc. 167, 6.
 5. Wholly, completely, Pañc. 72, 17.
 6. Comprehensively, Man. 2, 89.
 7. With, Nal. 9, 8.
 8. Together, Lass. 98, 14 = Rigv. v. 9, 5.
सम्राज् सम्-राज्, m. A paramount sovereign, one who rules over other princes, and has performed the Rājasūya sacrifice; a sovereign, Rājat. 5, 135.

सामग्र्य सामग्र्य, i. e. समग्र + य, n., and f. ग्री,
 1. Entireness, wholeness, the whole, Bhāṣāp. 63 (ग्री); Rām. 2, 70, 45, Seramp. (read प्राणसामग्र्यम्), []
 2. Perfection, Pañc. 109, 10 (ग्री).
 3. Stock, Hit. 130, 1 (ग्री); effects.
 4. Implements, apparatus, Pañc. iii. d. 129 (ग्री); utensils, 250, 5 (ग्री).
 5. Train, retinue, Hit. 98, 11 (य्री).
सामञ्जस्य सामञ्जस्य, i. e. समञ्जस + य, n. Fitness.

सामयिक सामयिक, i. e. समय + इक. adj.
 1. According to agreement, exact.
 2. Conventional, customary. []
 3. Seasonable.
 --Comp.

सामर्थ्य सामर्थ्य, i. e. समर्थ + य, n.
 1. Fitness, Rājat. 5, 308.
 2. Adequacy, Pañc. i. d. 215 (that which is adequate, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1873, v. r.); being entitled, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3027.
 3. Profit, Rām. 2, 61, 44, Seramp.
 4. Ability, Pañc. 263, 7.
 5. Strength, Rājat. 5, 384; power, Hit. ii. d. 140; fortitude, Bhag. 2, 36.
 6. Mutual relation of words.
 7. Sense of words.
 --Comp.
सामर्षता सामर्षता, i. e. स-अ-मर्ष + ता, f. Wrath, Ragh. 7, 41.

सामवायिक सामवायिक, i. e. समवाय + इक, m.
 1. The chief of a company or corporation.
 2. A principal minister.

सामानाधिकरण्य सामानाधिकरण्य, i. e. समान-अधिकरण + य, n.
 1. Common office.
 2. The condition of relating to the same object, Vedāntas. in Chr. 212, 21.
 3. The residing in the same substratum or subject, Kusumāñj. 14, 20.

सामान्य सामान्य, i. e. समान + य,
 I. adj.
 1. Common, Hit. i. d. 157, M.M.; Nal. 13, 17; in common, Pañc. 264, 2; base, Rājat. 5, 197; सामान्यतर, Very insignificant, not dexterous, Pañc. 133, 1.
 2. Equal, Śāk. d. 92.
 3. Generic.
 4. General, universal, whole.
 II. n.
 1. Totality.
 2. Public affairs, Man. 7, 56.
 3. Equanimity, Hit. i. d. 95, M.M.
 4. Common property, Hit. pr. d. 25, M.M.
 5. Kind, genus, or [] species, Bhāṣāp. 1; 7, 63.
 6. Identity, Vedāntas. in Chr. 210, 11.
 III. f. या, A whore.
 --Comp.

सामासिक सामासिक, i. e. समास + इक, adj.
 1. Compounded, Bhag. 10, 33; composite.
 2. Comprehensive, comprising the whole, Man. 7, 180; 10, 63.
 3. Summary, brief.

सामिधेन्य सामिधेन्य, i. e. सम्-इधेन्य (an old ptcple. of the fut. pass. of इन्ध्), + अ,
 I. m. A mantra or mystical prayer.
 II. f. नी,
 1. Fuel.
 2. A prayer used on adding fuel to the sacrificial fire.

सामीप्य सामीप्य i. e. समीप + य,
 I. m. A neighbour, Sāv. 2, 8.
 II. n. Proximity.

सामुद्रिक सामुद्रिक, i. e. स + मुद्र (cf. मुद्रा), + इक,
 I. adj. Relating to spots on the body, or the good or ill fortune supposed to be indicated by them.
 II. m. An interpreter of spots on the body.

साम्पराय साम्पराय, i. e. संपराय + अ
 I. adj. Warlike (?). MBh. 1, 723. []
 II. (n.),
 1. Future, MBh. 1, 1921.
 2. Future life, Bhāg. P. 8, 19, 2.

साम्परायिक साम्परायिक, i. e. संपराय + इक,
 I. adj.
 1. Relating to war, military, Man. 7, 185; warlike, Ragh. 17, 62.
 2. Calamitous.
 3. Future, relating to a future state, Man. 11, 30.
 II. n. War, battle.

साम्प्रतम् साम्प्रतम्, i. e. संप्रति + अ + म्, adv.
 1. Now, at this time, Pañc. 161, 18.
 2. Seasonably, fitly, properly.
 --Comp.
साम्प्रतिक साम्प्रतिक, i. e. सम्प्रति + इक, adj. Suitable, Utt. Rāmac. 73, 3.

साम्प्रदायिक साम्प्रदायिक, i. e. संप्रदाय + इक, adj. Belonging to traditional doctrine, transferred by traditional doctrine, Utt. Rāmac. 155, 8 (अ-, with नहि, Their tradition will not die out, they are hereditary).
साम्बवती साम्बवती, A proper name, Rājat. 5, 295.
साम्राज्य साम्राज्य, i. e. सम्राज् + य, n. Imperial rule, Man. 8, 387; sovereignty, Pañc. 42, 14; Rājat. 5, 49; 151.
साम्राज्यकृत् साम्राज्य-कृ + त्, adj. One who gains imperial rule, Man. 8, 387.
सामसिद्धि सामसिद्धि, i. e. सामन्-, f. the art of accomplishing something in a peaceable way, Pañc. 91, 17.
सम- + सुप्ति सम- + सुप्ति, f. universal sleep, the end of a Kalpa, and destruction of the world.
सम- + स्पर्श सम- + स्पर्श, adj. literally, having the same contact, i. e. 1. wounding like, Chr. 39, 5. 2. the touching of which has the same effect, viz. to defile, Pañc. iii. d. 118.
